blockers.why: The Nature endpoint returned HTML with HTTP 200; an author-hosted PDF URL returned 404; alternate USPTO responses returned HTTP 403 challenge pages. The accessible article metadata and Box 1 text were checked through publisher/PubMed pages and a surfaced author copy.
blockers.needed_for: Local full-text source artifact; no >1,024-variant numeric reproduction target was found in this paper.

verdict_reason: Huang et al. 2025 prints comparable >1,024-variant targets. Exact GraphFLA runs reproduce RCD1 NFC and reciprocal-sign prevalence, and the Kehe landscape NFC and all five square-class proportions. Higher-order R² mismatches on Kehe and Butyrate. DRI/ICI API values round to the table values but use different node-aggregated definitions than the paper's edgewise Pearson measures; the Kuo NFC and sampled reciprocal-sign outputs also miss table precision.
lead_review: 15 of 20 overlaps compare GraphFLA against Huang et al. 2025, the GraphFLA paper itself, and are therefore circular. They remain useful as regression snapshots. The independent entries all reported no printed number. Net independent scientific evidence from this record: none.
scope_limitation: The negative search conclusions in this record were reached under a >1,024-variant restriction. That cutoff scopes the SUPPLIED CORPUS only and does not apply to core literature, so a defining paper with a small landscape may have been skipped. Re-run these searches without the size restriction before concluding that a metric family has no published origin.
lead_correction: Operative outcomes corrected after external review: 10 circular comparisons relabelled regression_snapshot and 0 definition-mismatched numerical agreements relabelled definition_incompatible. Original claims preserved in each entry's original_agent_claim. A consumer filtering on reproduced_* now receives no rows from this record, which is correct: this record produced no independent scientific evidence.
